## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and any affected components.

## Validation

List the relevant test/build checks and any platform-specific behavior.

## Auto-merge eligibility

Check only after completing the review. The controller requires this exact attestation line to be checked:

- [ ] I reviewed source provenance and license attribution for this change.

Dependency manifest edits, workflow/automation edits, license/notice changes, draft PRs, stacked PRs, and branches behind `main` are not auto-merged and need explicit follow-up.
